notes: Corrected at the existential clause: the waw and 'ayin are fused on neither, carrying the existential frame is there and headed on the negative, rather than split with 'ayin holding is there any and heading on any. Rule 50 heads an existential on its negation word and never on a supplied one, and the accepted split left a negative existential with no negation word at all.
The supplied any joins mayim's unit under rule 15: the noun is bare, no kol stands on it, and the clause's negation is realized in the neither, so nothing else licenses the determiner.

Each coordinated rectum of meqom takes its own written of under rules 19 and 25, and the two articles of ha-maqom ha-ra' ha-zzeh are unrepresented because the demonstrative pronoun realizes the phrase's single determiner (rule 41).
